# The merge comment promises a badge within the hour

## Context

The comment an outside pull request gets at its merge says when the badge exists: "within the hour", in two sentences (`buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.mjs:245` and `:314`, `dev` at `6431e88cf2`). A scheduled workflow in `neomjs/pages` writes the badge, and its schedule does not hold the hour: 4 runs in 25 slots over twelve and a half hours, with gaps of up to 3 h 35 min (neomjs/pages#79, read of 2026-11-15 03:50Z). The decision this leaf carries out is on #20892, comment 6888799248.

## The Problem

- A first-time contributor is told the badge exists within the hour and gets an address that holds nothing for up to three and a half hours.
- A contributor at a later rung reads "Your badge shows it within the hour"; the same schedule decides.
- An account that merged before the badges went live and was out of the heads-up's reach (eight accounts, #20892) never learns of its record: a badge is named only at a first merge and at a rung.

## The Architectural Reality

- `decideMergeComment` (`:289`) is a pure function of what the workflow fetched; `.github/workflows/merge-comment.yml` only fetches and posts. The job already reads `badges/optout.json` of `neomjs/pages` with its own token (`:121`), so one more read of that public repository needs no credential.
- `hasFolder` (`:221`, private) answers whether the generator writes a folder for this author (badges on, not opted out). It does not know whether the folder is written yet.
- Badge words stand in the full form only (`:313-314`): `renderBadge` at a first merge, one sentence at a later rung. A merge between rungs names no badge.
- The generator of `neomjs/pages` imports `RUNGS`, `standing`, `BADGES_SINCE`, `badgeFolder`, `badgeLine` and the outside test from this module. None of them changes here.
- `Design authority:` #20892, comment 6888799248: "the badge line says what is true at that minute, and every merge comment links the record once it exists."

## The Fix

**The module.** `decideMergeComment` takes one more option, `folderWritten` (Boolean, default `false`): whether `badges/<login>-<id>/` is on `main` of `neomjs/pages` now. With `<url>` = `https://neomjs.com/badges/<login>-<id>/` and `<line>` = `badgeLine(login, id)`, an author the generator writes a folder for gets:

| Merge | `folderWritten` | Badge words |
| --- | --- | --- |
| the first | `true` | own paragraph: ``**Your badge**, if you would like to show it, is at <url> with three forms to choose from. The card's line:`` then, on the next line, `<line>` as code |
| the first | `false` | own paragraph: ``**Your badge**, if you would like to show it, is written by a scheduled run that has not counted this merge yet. From then on it is at <url> in three forms to choose from, and the card's line shows it:`` then, on the next line, `<line>` as code |
| a later rung | `true` | own paragraph: ``**Your badge** at <url> shows the new rung once a scheduled run has counted this merge.`` |
| between rungs | `true` | the standing line ends with `` Your record and badge: <url>`` |
| any after the first | `false` | none |

An author without a folder (badges off, on the opt-out list, or the list unread) gets no badge words in any row, as today. The private `hasFolder` gets a name that no longer reads like the new fact; the name is the builder's.

**The workflow.** After the opt-out read, and only when the list was read and does not hold the author: `github.rest.repos.getContent({owner, repo: 'pages', path: 'badges/' + badgeFolder(login, id), ref: 'main'})`. An answer means written. A `404` means not written. Anything else, including a login `badgeFolder` refuses, means not written plus a `core.warning`. No outcome of this read costs the comment. `badgeFolder` joins the import.

**The spec** (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.spec.mjs`): the five rows as whole strings; the opt-out cases with `folderWritten: true`; a sweep of every rendered form for a duration; in the workflow tests the folder read answered with content, with `404` and with `500`, and not requested for an opted-out author or an unread list.

**The words about it.** The module header, the JSDoc of `decideMergeComment` and the workflow's header comment say what the comment now reads.

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |

## Decision Record impact

none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: the five rows render exactly as in the table, each asserted as a whole string.
- [ ] AC-2: no comment body, in any state, contains `within`, `hour` or `minute`.
- [ ] AC-3: an author on the opt-out list, with the list unread or with badges off gets no badge words whatever `folderWritten` is, and the workflow sends no folder request for them.
- [ ] AC-4: the workflow reads an answer as written, a `404` as not written without a warning, and any other failure as not written with a warning. The comment is posted in all three.
- [ ] AC-5: the exports `neomjs/pages` reads are unchanged: their tests pass untouched, and the module still imports `claimResponse.mjs` only.
- [ ] AC-6: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] AC-7, after the merge and mine: the next outside merge's comment is read against the table, with its run's log, and recorded on #20892.

## Out of Scope

- Starting the badge run from the merge. It needs a credential with `actions: write` on `neomjs/pages`, which is the operator's to decide (#20892, comment 6888799248).
- The schedule itself (neomjs/pages#79).
- Whether the record address opens in a browser: today it does not (neomjs/middleware-v2#67). This leaf does not wait for that one.
- The guide (#20895), which takes its wording from here.
- The heads-up notes already posted.

## Avoided Traps

- **A longer time, such as "within a few hours".** Any duration is a promise the schedule decides. The comment reads the state instead.
- **Reading the site instead of the repository.** `neomjs.com` answers a runner as a bot. The folder on `main` is the fact the generator writes; the page follows the commit by the Pages build, about two minutes (four builds measured, 2026-11-14 and 11-15).
- **Naming the record at every merge whatever the folder's state.** A link to nothing is the defect this leaf removes.
